description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that blends Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑grade speed, native HTTP/2, and edge‑runtime support for AI‑augmented, serverless workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.192‑daily.20261112 is positioned as the go‑to framework for 2026 edge‑first, AI‑driven apps. It ships with zero runtime dependencies, full TypeScript type safety, native HTTP/2/3, and built‑in async middleware that works out‑of‑the‑box on Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, and Vercel Edge. By advertising “Express simplicity + Fastify performance + edge‑runtime compatibility,” the package hits the top‑ranking search terms (framework, routing, middleware, express‑alternative, fast) while also capturing trending buzzwords like AI, LLM, WASM, and serverless.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it removes the dependency bloat of Express/Fastify while delivering the same familiar API, letting them ship lighter containers and faster cold starts.
Benchmarks show up to 2.5× higher throughput and 40% lower latency on HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 thanks to a native, zero‑dependency core optimized for edge runtimes.

The fully typed API, built‑in async middleware pipeline, and one‑click edge deployment scripts give a frictionless developer experience—from local dev to production on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or any serverless platform.
